title: A Signal for the Colony
author: Quentin Sandoval
blurb: Odile Montrose, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
